objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: But we also need to consider other Xiang strategies that do not split each big piece exactly once. We argued they give Liu at least as much. Need to prove best response for Xiang among all allowed splits is indeed to split each big once (any way).
objection.witness: The 'invariance' lemma is proved only under the assumption that Xiang splits every big piece exactly once (2n+1 pieces). The claim that all other Xiang responses are at least as good for Liu is asserted from two hand-checked examples, never proved — and is in fact false.
